content: As a project administrator, I want to export the requirements traceability matrix (RTM) as a CSV file to share with customers during acceptance. Acceptance criteria: (1) the file includes requirement, goal, problem, and status columns; (2) downloads in under 3 seconds for 500 rows; (3) only administrators can access it.
expected_quality: Medium-high - story has actor, value, testable acceptance criteria (fairly good INVEST); traceability may be reduced if it lacks a clear parent goal link.
